Data Requirement Gathering: Identify and document data requirements, schemas, integration points, and data flow specifications
CI_CD Pipeline Development: Design and implement continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines for automation
Data Development: Develop database schemas, data models, ETL processes, and data transformation logic
Data Test Support: Support data validation, data quality testing, and data migration testing
Environment Provisioning: Set up and configure development, staging, and production environments with required infrastructure
NFR Gathering: Collect and document Non-Functional Requirements (performance, security, scalability, availability)
Penetration Test Scenario Development: Design realistic security attack scenarios and test cases to identify vulnerabilities
Penetration Test Execution: Conduct authorized penetration testing to evaluate system security posture
Penetration Test Report: Document penetration test findings, risk assessments, and remediation recommendations
Performance Test Scripting: Create automated test scripts to simulate realistic user loads and transactions
Performance Test Execution: Execute load and stress testing to validate system performance against requirements
Capacity Monitoring: Continuously monitor system resource utilization (CPU, memory, storage, network) and track growth trends
Capacity Planning: Forecast future capacity needs and plan infrastructure scaling to support business growth
E2E Monitoring: End-to-end transaction and user experience monitoring across all system components and services
FinOps: Optimize cloud and IT infrastructure costs through monitoring, allocation, and resource efficiency management
Incident Management: Detect, respond to, and resolve system incidents with defined severity levels and escalation procedures
Problem Management: Investigate root causes of recurring incidents and implement permanent solutions to prevent recurrence
Self Repairing: Implement automated recovery mechanisms and self-healing capabilities to restore system functionality
